szoveg_eredeti:
Your performance data shows what’s working days before the next round of creative is ready. Runway Ads Lab is a hands-on workshop in San Francisco to close that gap.

Performance, growth and brand marketers will build together in Runway Ads. You’ll take real results from Meta, Google and TikTok and turn them into new on-brand creative, and you approve every ad before it goes live.

You’ll test more ideas in one afternoon than most teams get through in a week. After the workshop, stay for drinks with the Runway Ads team and other Bay Area marketers.

San Francisco · November 19

Space is limited and registration requires approval. Request a spot: https://luma.com/runway-r1bt
